name: Flame Foe
body:
School abjuration; Level cleric/oracle 3, inquisitor 3, magus 3, sorcerer/wizard 3

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action

Components V, S, M/DF (a white dragon scale)

EFFECT

Range personal

Target you

Duration 10 min./level

You gain spell resistance equal to 10 + your caster level against spells with the fire descriptor.
